name: StreetFighter
author: GigiMx
description: In this game the player will attach the enemy. The player will use his sword to kill the enemy. In order for the player to stay alive is to avoid contact with the enemy if too much contact is made then the player is dead. If the player hit the enemy 4 times with the sword, then enemy will be dead. https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/audio/music/orchestral/action-soundtrack-mp3-70362 , https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/2d/characters/bandits-pixel-art-104130
